title: Hercules showcase compositions
question: Which composition should carry forward? All preserve the existing graphite/copper identity and the agreed page order.

options.label: Editorial demonstration
options.thesis: One generous native player with an evidence rail makes the investigation easy to follow.
options.viewport: Wide hero, single player and evidence rail, then expandable chains and an architectural cutaway.
options.risk: The rail must remain concise so the native interface stays dominant.

options.label: Terminal stage
options.thesis: The native interface takes the full stage, followed by a large container cutaway.
options.viewport: Wide hero, oversized player with a findings strip, then chains and architecture.
options.risk: An oversized terminal can push useful context too far below the fold.

options.label: Investigation timeline
options.thesis: A connected evidence trail links each tool call to the next decision.
options.viewport: Wide hero, player beside a case timeline, then tool chains and a continuous evidence path.
options.risk: Connections need restraint to keep the page from becoming a dashboard.
